Definition: Bamoth or Bamoth-Baal, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Bamoth, also called Bamoth-baal, is a place east of the Jordan where Israel camped on the way to the promised land. It is named again when the land was divided among the tribes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the camps of the wilderness were not wasted miles, and every named stopping place, Bamoth among them, marks a step in God's leading.
